candidates.term: The Sage inside the Year Gate
candidates.defline: Care lives inside your Year Gate: your root is shelter itself, deep and possibly too warm.
candidates.reading: This position rules Family and Health. The root of your beginnings is protection: a childhood cushioned, a mother-force strong in the walls, safety as the house style. It gave you a nervous system that heals and a baseline trust most people lack. The shade side is late launching, shelter that lingered into softness. Whatever you were protected from, go meet a sized version of it yearly. Roots this kind must be outgrown gratefully, not obeyed.
